name: Lacerating Strike
description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, cause them to bleed profusely. The creature must make a Fortitude saving throw. On a fail, they take your damage equal to twice your proficiency bonus at the start of their turn for 1 minute. The next time the creature is healed, it regains no Hit Points, and the bleeding stops. The bleeding can also be stopped by a creature making a Wisdom (Medicine) check against your Prowess save DC as a Major Action.
